suppress.notes: docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1 is the newest upstream transport available to Testcontainers 2.0.5 as of 2026-08-21. CVE-2026-71290 affects only the asynchronous HttpClient implementation; ApacheDockerHttpClientImpl uses CloseableHttpClient's classic implementation. Re-evaluate when Docker Java publishes a newer transport.

docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1 shades HttpCore 5.3.6 and has no patched upstream release as of 2026-08-21. Testcontainers uses this test-scoped client only against the trusted local Docker daemon: it does not use HTTP/2 (CVE-2026-54428), and a malicious Docker daemon capable of exploiting the HTTP/1.1 parser (CVE-2026-54399) already owns the privileged test boundary. Re-evaluate when Docker Java issue 2651 is resolved.
